history.overview: The Outer Citadel was the first phase of Muramite construction, built to secure their foothold in Kuua.

timeline.name: Foundation Layer
timeline.description: Muramite engineers laid the foundation stones using enslaved Dragorn labor.

timeline.name: Barracks Construction
timeline.description: Barracks and training yards were erected to house Muramite troops.

timeline.name: Hall Reinforcement
timeline.description: Great halls were reinforced with Discord‑infused stone.

timeline.name: Gatehouse Fortification
timeline.description: Outer gatehouses were fortified to repel Dragorn counterattacks.
